# Glossary

| Term | Definition | Ontology resources | Forbidden synonyms |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shipment | A load of goods moving from one site to one site, carried by one Carrier. | carrier | consignment, delivery |
| Carrier | A company that moves a Shipment. | Carrier, shipments | haulier |
| Delay reason | The reason a Shipment is late, chosen from a fixed list. | Shipment, ReportDelay | late code |
